ordinal_dispositions.summary: Six-layer memory/persistence architecture documentation is a useful topology/index source but not independent proof that every described retrieval, causal-learning or consciousness integration was active at this version.

Download files that failed age/size qualification were previously marked known without notification, causing silent future loss. Consumer cursor/known-state must advance only after accepted processing/ack or preserve retry eligibility.

Live wallpaper service was removed from runtime/watchdog and replaced with generated static wallpaper while hardware/status UI changed. Presentation topology is versioned and self-rendered visuals remain endogenous output, not independent sensor evidence.

Overlay moved from repeated topmost/fullscreen/panel enforcement hacks to native X11 DOCK+strut semantics, deleting large polling/enforcement code. Prefer authoritative platform coordination primitives over recurring corrective loops when available.
README switched quick-start to release binary. Strong autonomy/emergence cautions in README remain historical claims, not runtime proof.
Large README refresh enumerated services/models/entities/safety/vision/install state. Useful version-bound topology index only; later commits immediately changed voice/wallpaper/entity scheduling.

Stale voice cancellation flag suppressed later TTS until reset per request; narrative multi-step phrases falsely triggered agentic mode until an action verb was also required. Ephemeral control state must be request-scoped and intent heuristics need conjunctive evidence/collision tests.

TUI installer added multi-method system/GPU detection, interactive choices and visible step progress around install.sh. Detection is evidence with fallback provenance, not a single guessed hardware label; subprocess outcome remains authoritative over UI progress.
Wake-word voice daemon was disabled and removed from watchdog while push-to-talk remained. Watchdogs must monitor current capability topology, not restart intentionally removed components.

Installer expanded to 13 stages, builds/venvs/models/voice/services and GPU-specific configuration. A notable regression removed optional model checksum verification, reinforcing that successful download is not artifact integrity; deployment receipts need hashes/version pins and semantic probes.
Entity dispatcher polling changed 60s→600s. Resource/latency tradeoff only; cadence is an explicit policy parameter and must be measured rather than treated as intelligence.

Entity turn delays became 5s-interruptible and aborted when user returned, preventing ghost GPU activity. Background autonomy requires bounded cancellation latency and priority handoff to live user activity.

System messages were persisted for UI continuity while intended conversation context remained separately filtered; agentic LLM cancellation moved toward sub-second polling. Durable UI history and model-context eligibility are distinct policies.

All messages including system records entered SQLite, but system messages were explicitly excluded from LLM context ring restoration; LLM network calls ran in cancellable subthreads. Store-everything-for-audit does not imply inject-everything-into-inference, and cancellation acknowledgment does not necessarily terminate underlying daemon I/O.

importlib.reload duplicated log handlers until guarded; dispatcher exact string matching failed once exit reasons carried details. Initialization side effects must be idempotent across reload, and outcomes should be structured enums+metadata rather than brittle free-text parsing.

Five fixed timers became one idle-driven serial dispatcher with daily quotas and returned exit reasons; user-interrupted sessions did not consume quota. Central arbitration reduces collision, but completion/error/quota semantics must be explicit and interruption must not be miscounted as completed work.

README documented E-PQ feedback, entity personality learning, overlap gates and resource behavior. Preserve as historical claims/index; keyword-triggered E-PQ and stated micro/macro 'learning' require code/runtime evidence and should not be upgraded by documentation terminology alone.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Download watcher marked filtered files known and thereby made future valid events invisible.
distilled_invariants.validation: Crash/retry/filter tests prove an event cannot become permanently skipped merely because it was observed before qualification; cursor update is atomic with accepted disposition or explicit discard receipt.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: System notifications needed persistence across UI restarts but should not automatically enter conversational LLM context.
distilled_invariants.validation: Each record has source/type/trust plus persist_policy and context_policy; replay shows system/audit records survive storage while only explicitly eligible records enter inference.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: A stale cancellation flag from prior thinking suppressed a new voice response.
distilled_invariants.validation: Cancellation IDs/generation tokens bind flags to one operation; new request cannot inherit stale cancel unless explicitly linked.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Long sleeps and blocking LLM calls delayed reaction when the user returned or cancelled.
distilled_invariants.validation: Every wait/IO/effect phase exposes cancellation checkpoints; user-priority takeover has measured maximum latency and terminal interruption receipt.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Agentic HTTP call moved to daemon thread and caller could return cancelled while underlying blocking request could still finish independently.
distilled_invariants.validation: Receipts separately state caller_cancelled, transport_cancelled and side_effect_terminated; unsafe/effectful operations require true cancellation or compensating isolation rather than detached continuation.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Module reload stacked duplicate logging handlers.
distilled_invariants.validation: Repeated import/reload/restart leaves exactly one handler/subscription/timer per intended registration and no duplicate effects/events.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Dispatcher exact matching broke when exit_reason became 'user_returned (idle=15s)'.
distilled_invariants.validation: Outcome schema uses enum code plus typed metadata; no quota/safety decision depends on string-prefix interpretation.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Disabled voice/live-wallpaper services had to be removed from watchdog supervision.
distilled_invariants.validation: Supervisor derives monitored set from resolved capability graph/version and refuses restart of intentionally disabled/removed component.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Native X11 DOCK/strut replaced large topmost/fullscreen enforcement loops.
distilled_invariants.validation: Choose OS/native ownership primitive where it exists; fallback polling must be explicit degraded mode with bounded cadence and conflict telemetry.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Installer rewrite retained retry/download flow but removed prior optional checksum verification.
distilled_invariants.validation: External artifacts have pinned source/version/hash/size/signature where available, then executable and semantic readiness probes before promotion.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Narrative 'and then' phrases triggered agentic execution until paired with an action verb.
distilled_invariants.validation: Held-out multilingual negatives include narrative sequencing, quoted commands and ambiguous verbs; false-positive effectful routing is measured separately from recall.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: User-returned sessions should not consume daily entity quota while true completions do.
distilled_invariants.validation: Quota mutation is atomic with terminal structured outcome; interrupted/retried/error states have explicit accounting policy and idempotent event ID.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: README described entity micro/macro 'learning', E-PQ influence and emergent dynamics while underlying mechanisms included authored keyword/event rules.
distilled_invariants.validation: Scientific synthesis labels docs as claims; LEARNED requires observed parameter/rule adaptation with held-out validation and exact runtime provenance.

retina_transfer.mapping: Retina frame/event consumers must not advance known/cursor state before accepted processing; sensor/percept records can persist without automatic LLM-context injection; classifier/background jobs must be cancellable with bounded user-priority preemption; cancellation receipts distinguish caller return from real compute/effect termination; classifier initialization/reload is idempotent; learning claims cannot come from documentation or authored heuristic labels.

negative_results.result: Observed but filtered downloads were marked known, making later valid notification impossible.
Stale per-request cancellation state suppressed a later voice response; narrative sequencing text falsely triggered agentic mode.
30–60 second uninterruptible turn sleeps let background entity work continue after user return, causing ghost GPU spikes.
Caller-side cancellation of a daemon-thread HTTP request does not prove the underlying network/inference work actually terminated.
Module reload duplicated log handlers; exact free-text exit-reason equality misclassified outcomes once diagnostic details were appended.
Installer evolution removed checksum verification, showing richer deployment automation can regress artifact-integrity evidence.
